label: Ainslie Glen Brook / Skye River confluence
phase: Fresh check of frozen four-control physical affine; no fitting or model-selection use
point_definition: Junction of engraved single-line streams and original NSTDB WARV50 centreline node; not the nearby road junction or bridge.
identity_evidence: Broad source context traces Skye River southeast from Skye Glen toward Whycocomagh Bay. Ainslie Glen Brook approaches from the northeast valley and meets it just north of Indian Rear. Mullach Brook joins the Ainslie Glen branch farther northeast before that stream reaches Skye; its labelled east-side tributary and the intervening road crossings distinguish the two junctions. Modern named original network has the same order: Mullach/Ainslie node at [-61.14697976419124,46.00990235179478], then Ainslie/Skye at the recorded reference. MacDonalds Brook reaches Skye farther upstream from the west. Road crossings and labels corroborate locality only.
